concerns.text: The PT→SOC mapping fetch is not executable as specified: 'Primary candidate: the NLM's free MedDRA–SNOMED mapping / MedDRA hierarchy files (https://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/mapped-projects/meddra_snomed_ct.html), or a published PT→SOC table reachable from the VAERS SYMPTOMVERSION files.' No concrete file URL, format, or parsing recipe is given — an implementer cannot deterministically produce the mapping, and T004's ≥95% coverage gate depends on it. Name the exact downloadable artifact and its expected schema (or specify the fallback resolution procedure concretely).

Checksum output location is contradictory: the body says 'append data/checksums.txt lines', but verification requires 'logs/download_checksums.txt lists every year × file with OK'. Pick one path (or specify both are written) so the verification command points at a real artifact.

Verification says the one-liner 'writes "PASS" to logs/config_import.txt', but the command `python -c "...; print('PASS')"` prints to stdout — nothing writes the file. Specify redirection (`> logs/config_import.txt`) or an explicit file write inside the check.

Validation check 5 ('proportion of flagged signals satisfying the 2-out-of-3 rule reported (SC-005, FR-005)') has no pass condition — SC-005's threshold is [deferred] (sanctioned), but then check 5 must state what makes it PASS vs FAIL (e.g., 'report the proportion; PASS iff every is_signal=True row satisfies the rule', which is already check-redundant with T006). Define the pass predicate or mark the check as report-only.

The IC metric and its 95% Wald CI formula are never specified anywhere in tasks/plan (ROR and PRR are standard, but IC has multiple conventions — log2 observed/expected with variance per Norén et al. vs. simpler versions). Name the formula (or a citable reference implementation) so the hand-checkable unit test and the finite-value check are deterministic.
